intro: Dots is OpenAI's always-on agent: it learns your preferences and goals, works on its own cloud computer, and connects to thousands of apps through ChatGPT, Slack, and Teams. That persistence is real, and it lives inside OpenAI's closed cloud. GAIA takes a different route. It is open source and self-hostable, so its memory and roadmap stay under your control. It connects to the tools you live in and works from web, mobile, WhatsApp, and Telegram.
